meta.name: landing-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "optimize our landing page for influencer traffic", "fix our promo-code landing page", or "improve conversion from a creator campaign"; produces a message-match audit, page-structure and social-proof recommendations, a promo-code/CTA conversion plan, and an A/B test roadmap. Not for measuring campaign results after launch — use performance-analyzer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化落地页以提升创作者流量转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为创作者活动优化落地页的转化效果。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize landing pages to boost conversion from creator traffic.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're optimizing landing pages for influencer campaigns.

howto.what: 分析落地页与网红内容的匹配度，给出页面结构、社交证明、转化优化和A/B测试建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求优化网红流量落地页、修复促销码落地页或提升创作者活动转化率时触发。

say.text: 优化我们为@fitnessanna的蛋白粉活动做的落地页。
say.note: 触发完整诊断和优化计划。

say.text: 我们的网红落地页转化率只有1.2%，怎么改进？
say.note: 分析问题并给出优先级修复建议。

say.text: 为这个促销码落地页做一个A/B测试计划。
say.note: 生成测试假设和成功指标。

howto.what_en: Audits message match between influencer content and landing page, then provides recommendations on page structure, social proof, promo-code/CTA conversion, and an A/B test roadmap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to optimize a landing page for influencer traffic, fix a promo-code landing page, or improve conversion from a creator campaign.

say_en.text: Optimize our landing page for @fitnessanna's protein powder campaign.
say_en.note: Triggers full diagnosis and optimization plan.

say_en.text: Our influencer landing page has only 1.2% conversion. How can we improve it?
say_en.note: Analyzes issues and suggests priority fixes.

say_en.text: Create an A/B test plan for this promo-code landing page.
say_en.note: Generates test hypotheses and success metrics.
